entry_count.description: Pinned here AND cross-checked against the real record count by DialogicEntryManifest.validate_document as ENTRY_MANIFEST_ENTRY_COUNT_MISMATCH. Both halves stay live because the code law is reachable without changing this value: appending a record leaves entry_count schema-valid while making it disagree with reality. day_entry_count and ending_entry_count are deliberately NOT pinned, because their cross-checks run after the partition law and the only mutation that reaches them is the declared value itself, so a const there would make the code half unreachable. Measured, not assumed.

day_entry_count.description: Declared number of records that own a day master, which is 121 across the seven day files. Cross-checked against the real tally by DialogicEntryManifest.validate_document as ENTRY_MANIFEST_ENTRY_COUNT_MISMATCH.

ending_entry_count.description: Declared number of records that own no day and present an ending identity instead, which is the 18 callable entries the specification 13.8 table expands to. Cross-checked against the real tally by DialogicEntryManifest.validate_document as ENTRY_MANIFEST_ENTRY_COUNT_MISMATCH.

entries.description: minItems is the schema half of a defence-in-depth pair with the ENTRY_MANIFEST_ENTRY_COUNT_MISMATCH cross-check in DialogicEntryManifest.validate_document. Sub-commit 2A mutation site S08 deleted it and the whole suite still passed, so test_the_published_schema_declares_exactly_the_closed_vocabularies now asserts it directly; do not remove either half. uniqueItems is deliberately absent, because it could only catch byte-identical records, which is strictly weaker than the two laws that matter - a duplicate entry_id and a duplicate {path,label} locator pair - and both of those are named code laws.

day.description: An int from 1 to 7 on a day entry and null on an ending entry. JsonSchemaValidator implements no nullable union and no oneOf, so DialogicEntryManifest.validate_document owns this as ENTRY_MANIFEST_ENDING_PARTITION_INVALID.

ending_id.description: A non-empty stable ending id on one of the eighteen 13.8 presentation entries and null on all others, including the three Day 7 ending invitations, which offer an ending without presenting one. Owned by ENTRY_MANIFEST_ENDING_PARTITION_INVALID for the same reason as day.

allowed_signals.description: minItems is deliberately absent. The real law is that every entry carries history.line.witness, which no implemented keyword can express; it lives in validate_document as ENTRY_MANIFEST_SIGNAL_LIST_INVALID.
